scope: Recovered-client Training Day mission 1526 interaction, pistol turn-in and persistence after relog
client: Recovered 1.16.5.0 client; current compatibility build, not proven final shutdown revision
diagnostic_inputs: Run 46 copied the completed mission-1995 run-42 character database and moved the character to (768.0,294.12,386.05), about 3 m from seeded Kincaid. This bypassed normal walking from Rogers.
Run 47 copied the run-46 post-turn-in character database without a teleport; both runs used the isolated world seed.

observations.finding: The compatible client showed Kincaid beside the Alia Das barracks with an objective-completion indicator. Right click opened Training Day objective completion text and a Continue button.
Continue completed objective 1. A second conversation opened mission completion text, showed 120 credits and selectable Pistol and Pulse Pistol rewards.

Hover showed the emulator Pistol tooltip (91 Physical Damage, 20 m optimal range, 115 Physical Melee Damage, Standard Grade Cartridges 12/20, Firearms 1 Novice, minimum level 5). Clicking it enabled Complete Mission. The original B2-026 footage calls this Vextronics Pistol and shows a Reduce Resist module line; the emulator item lacks both server-supplied details.

The client sent CompleteNPCMission. The copied database records mission 1526 state 4, objective 1 status 2, credits 350 to 470, experience unchanged at 8124, and new item 17 of template 116929 in character inventory.
After relog, the Training Day tracker and Kincaid completion indicator were gone; mission completion, 470 credits and pistol template 116929 persisted.

limitations: The tests use the emulator and compatible recovered client; final-live reward values and presentation are not independently proved by this run.

The source footage B2-023/026/029 and early-2008 archived mission database conflict on credits (120 partly legible in footage versus 180 in the older database); this run verifies the seeded 120, not the final-live amount.
Kincaid position and pistol template ids remain inferred; normal route from boot-camp exit to trainer was bypassed.
The run-46 harness received SIGTERM after CompleteNPCMission, before the requested post-completion screenshot. Database state and run-47 relog independently show completion.

The original B2-026 item-module name and effect survive in footage, but the module id and attachment data were not recovered. The selected item therefore has a visible and possibly mechanical mismatch with the footage.
